execution_source_note: This commit links the unchanged frozen inputs. It is not claimed as the exact execution checkout: results.json records the v0.17.0 base plus exact hashes of the experimental evaluator and runtime sources.
hash_note: Frozen-file SHA-256 values cover raw bytes. Evaluator hashes cover JSON.stringify of validated values in their key order. The harness attached split/family metadata before the evaluator fixture hash. Provider submission hashes use sorted-key canonical JSON with the provider model name.

omitted_fields.reason: Private temporary infrastructure identifier; the field line is removed without reserializing any remaining result bytes.

preservation: All remaining result bytes are unchanged. Counts, case ordering, scores, errors, skips, routes, token counts, times, and recorded hashes are preserved. The original report already excluded credentials, input state, question text, and raw provider bodies.

combined_summary.method: Combine initial provider submissions with the separate continuation of never-submitted cases. The first-run local abort is preserved in the original report and is superseded here by that case's first provider submission. No model request was retried. Errors remain separate from graded incorrect answers.
